import math
import numpy as np

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) for fiscal years 1933-1941
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
years = sorted(expenditures.keys())
log_growth_rates = []

for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    prev_exp = expenditures[prev_year]
    curr_exp = expenditures[curr_year]
    log_growth = math.log(curr_exp / prev_exp)
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    print(f"{curr_year}: ln({curr_exp}/{prev_exp}) = ln({curr_exp/prev_exp:.4f}) = {log_growth:.4f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")
print(f"Mean: {np.mean(log_growth_rates):.4f}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {np.std(log_growth_rates, ddof=0):.4f}")
print(f"Coefficient of Variation: {np.std(log_growth_rates, ddof=0) / np.mean(log_growth_rates):.4f}")

# Calculate CV
mean = np.mean(log_growth_rates)
pop_std = np.std(log_growth_rates, ddof=0)
cv = pop_std / mean

print(f"\n=== Final Answer ===")
print(f"Mean: {mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {pop_std:.6f}")
print(f"Coefficient of Variation (volatility index): {cv:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(cv, 2)}")
EOF

import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) for fiscal years 1933-1941
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
years = sorted(expenditures.keys())
log_growth_rates = []

for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    prev_exp = expenditures[prev_year]
    curr_exp = expenditures[curr_year]
    log_growth = math.log(curr_exp / prev_exp)
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    print(f"{curr_year}: ln({curr_exp}/{prev_exp}) = ln({curr_exp/prev_exp:.4f}) = {log_growth:.4f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")

# Calculate mean
n = len(log_growth_rates)
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean:.6f}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population Std Dev: {pop_std:.6f}")

# Calculate coefficient of variation (CV)
cv = pop_std / mean

print(f"\n=== Final Answer ===")
print(f"Mean: {mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {pop_std:.6f}")
print(f"Coefficient of Variation (volatility index): {cv:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(cv, 2)}")

python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) for fiscal years 1933-1941
# 1941 value of 6301 already includes emergency ship construction (footnote 2 in Table 4)
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # Includes emergency ship construction starting March 1941
}

print("National Defense Expenditures (millions of dollars):")
for year, exp in expenditures.items():
    print(f"  {year}: ${exp:,} million")

print("\n--- Year-to-Year Log Growth Rates ---")
# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
years = sorted(expenditures.keys())
log_growth_rates = []

for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    prev_exp = expenditures[prev_year]
    curr_exp = expenditures[curr_year]
    log_growth = math.log(curr_exp / prev_exp)
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    print(f"  {curr_year}: ln({curr_exp}/{prev_exp}) = {log_growth:.6f}")

# Calculate statistics
n = len(log_growth_rates)
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / n
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)
cv = pop_std / mean

print(f"\n--- Statistics ---")
print(f"Number of log growth rates: {n}")
print(f"Mean of log growth rates: {mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {pop_std:.6f}")
print(f"Coefficient of Variation (CV): {pop_std:.6f} / {mean:.6f} = {cv:.6f}")
print(f"\n>>> EXPENDITURE VOLATILITY INDEX: {round(cv, 2)} <<<")
EOF
